verdict.rationale: Canva's own documented export capability (via the MCP server) produces designs in open or standard formats such as PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX and MP4, which covers the core of getting content out. Nothing shows a bulk or account-wide export of all data (assets, comments, brand kits, editable design sources) or a documented exit path. missing for 10: bulk export of all account data, export of editable or source-level design data in open formats, a documented account data-takeout/offboarding path, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Design export:** Generate exports in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4, and so on)
